title: Althaea officinalis tincture for medicinal use
intro: Althaea officinalis tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the roots and leaves of the marshmallow plant. It is commonly used in herbalism for its soothing and demulcent properties, which help to calm irritated mucous membranes. This preparation is often employed to treat respiratory conditions such as coughs and sore throats due to its ability to ease inflammation. It may also be used topically to soothe skin irritations and promote healing. In traditional medicine, it has been valued for its mild, calming effects on the body.
